roles.role_need: Keep paying customers by resolving their problems quickly.
Keep the billing platform correct and available.

traits.definition: Writes and tests a small Python service change that passes review without major rework.
observable_evidence: work sample passes 8 of 10 hidden tests
structured interview Q3 score of 3 or more out of 5
traits.why_it_predicts: Most tickets are Python changes to billing services.

traits.definition: Finds the cause of a seeded production bug from logs within 45 minutes.
observable_evidence: debugging exercise: root cause named and fix proposed in 45 minutes
traits.why_it_predicts: The team is on call and owns uptime.

roles.role_need: Cut stock and cost errors in warehouse reporting.

traits.definition: Finds seeded errors in a reconciliation sheet.
observable_evidence: finds 4 of 5 seeded errors in exercise
traits.why_it_predicts: Errors in weekly reports drive stock losses.
